item.title: Australian PM says lawmaker critically hurt by car is 'no accident'
item.description: A car struck an Australian federal independent lawmaker on Monday, critically injuring her in an apparent deliberate attack, said Prime Minister Anthony Albanese.

item.title: Kelvin wave raised West Coast sea levels; more expected
item.description: A large underwater wave moved up the West Coast, raising sea levels. Scientists say it is driven by El Niño and will happen again.
